config.reward: visible score difference only, constant scale for optimizer
config.training_policy: learned Q-values with training-only persistent fixed-distribution random exploration
config.replay_resume: refill from new own experience; no saved trajectories loaded
config.resume_semantics: online, target, optimizer and RNG restored; episodes restart from boot
config.curriculum_trigger_semantics: actual same-life state L decisions before visible loss; immediate stage entry; not a physical-collision timestamp; no snapshots restored during evaluation
config.curriculum_selection: bounded largest own-life-age cells; uniform reset among oldest frontier bins
config.curriculum_age_semantics: own actions since visible ship loss or stage boundary; training resets only
config.exploration_duration: bounded power law proportional to length**(-exponent)
config.exploration_epsilon: nominal uninterrupted exploratory-step fraction; boundary cuts can reduce it
config.exploration_warmup: unchanged independent uniform actions until replay warmup
config.exploration_reset: cancel on visible ship loss, termination or truncation; no screen-triggered starts
config.exploration_resume: restore separate RNG; active holds and local counters clear with new boot episodes
config.exploration_actions_semantics: equal mass for twelve stage-1 command groups; forward-fire aliases share one group; fixed across all screens/stages; all twenty actions remain possible; warmup and greedy evaluation unchanged; not a route or state-conditioned rule
config.exploration_worker_roles: first curriculum_boot_envs use fixed boot epsilon; others use schedule
config.exploration_worker_warmup: all workers remain independent uniform until replay warmup
